name: deep-berry
description: Example target palette for `npm run retheme` (scripts/retheme.ts) — the teal→deep-berry mapping used by the NP Hiring pilot fork. Copy this file, keep the role keys, change the hex values. Roles mirror TEMPLATE_PALETTE: primary #0D9488, primaryDark #0F766E, primaryDeep #115E59+#134E4A, primaryLight #14B8A6, pale #2DD4BF, paleLight #5EEAD4, chipLight #99F6E4, chip #B2F5EA, chipTint #CCFBF1, tint #F0FDFA. rgb()/rgba() tints are derived from the role hexes automatically (alpha preserved).
